text:
Rina (Growth): Heads-up: publishing webinar landing + three launch posts next week. Need a compact SEO action list today: keyword targets per post, structured data snippets (Webinar + FAQ where applicable), internal anchor plan, and redirect tidy-up for legacy /events and /webinars slugs. Lock content by COB PT.
Tom (SEO): I'll own keyword mapping and anchor text. Plan: 2 primaries + 1 longtail per page, with SERP intent tags. Will populate the shared sheet and flag any competing titles.
Haley (Content): Drafts uploaded to the doc. I'll add 160-char metas and suggested slugs. Suggest keeping separate canonicals for evergreen posts; mass-301 only for duplicate splash pages.
Ivy (Webops): For SSR pages we put JSON-LD in <head>. For client-rendered routes we prerender the snippet. Quick example we'll use for the webinar event (sharing as string here):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-08-18T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Tom (SEO): Internal link plan (summary): landing -> /product/inference (anchors: "LLM inference platform", "high-throughput inference"), benchmark post -> /benchmarks (anchors: "latency & cost benchmarks", "inference test results"), recap -> /resources/webinars (anchors: "watch on-demand", "webinar recording"). I'll add three anchor variants per destination in the sheet.
Haley (Content): OG image 1200x630 uploaded. Ivy, can you queue CDN invalidation after staging deploy?
Ivy (Webops): Yup. Also will implement redirect rules for known old slugs. Example nginx rule (preserve querystring): `return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/serve-llms?$query_string;` I'll whitelist slugs to avoid accidental chains.
seo-bot: Preflight checks to pass: unique title tags, unique meta descriptions, single H1, JSON-LD present for event/faq where relevant, internal links with descriptive anchors, redirects are 301 with no chains, sitemap updated and pinged.
Rina (Growth): Quick decisions: evergreen posts keep their own canonicals; redirect duplicate event splash pages to the new landing. Haley mark each old slug as keep/301 in the sheet.
Tom (SEO): I'll also check for title collisions with existing resource pages and propose variations if needed.
Haley (Content): One Q: do we want FAQ schema on the benchmark post, or only on the recap? I think recap benefits most.
Tom (SEO): Agree—recap gets FAQ. Benchmark can include structured data for dataset/schema if we publish raw graphs.
Ivy (Webops): I'll add sitemap entries with priority 0.8 and changefreq weekly at publish time. seo-bot, schedule a re-run after staging deploy?
seo-bot: Scheduled. Will report duplicates and missing H1s.
Rina (Growth): Owners & deadlines: Haley - final copy + metas + slug decisions (EOD today); Tom - keyword buckets + anchor variants (EOD today); Ivy - redirect implementation + JSON-LD placement + sitemap (tomorrow AM); seo-bot - final audit after staging. Ping me if any blocker before content freeze at 5pm PT. Thanks team!
